newsitem.title: GERMANY: MOTOR RACING-MERCEDES RETURN TO SPORTSCAR RACING.
newsitem.headline: MOTOR RACING-MERCEDES RETURN TO SPORTSCAR RACING.

text.p: Mercedes Benz are returning to international sportscar racing for the first time in six years.
The three-car team will be led by Mercedes 1995 international touring car champion German Bernd Schneider and former Italian Formula One driver Alessandro Nannini.
The cars, based on the C-Class Coupe road model, are powered by a production-based V12 engine.
They will compete against Porsche, BMW, McLaren, Lotus and Ferrari in the world championship series, which has 11 races, starting at Hockenheim on April 13.
